v0.9.0 adds rapid estimation of concrete and rebar quantities from structural drawings, with plan-level accuracy.

- Fully integrates and replaces the original cad-file-reader pipeline for beam, slab, column, wall, stair, opening, precast slab, model, and concrete split operations.
- One-click extraction of floor concrete volumes, grade partition, and rebar bands from any CAD plan, using indexed cache and configuration per drawing.
- Automatically assists with normative/meta-data checks, loss, splits (such as post-cast strips), config inheritance, and generates missing-input reports instead of using defaults.
- Output strictly for planning purposes (±5–10% error), not for shop drawings, labor, or settlement.
- Significant improvements in reliability, traceability, cache versioning, and error reporting for unrecognized structural tables and grids.
